dimensions.name: past work
dimensions.evidence: Owned agent design, product/order tools, and core backend for KKday trip planner handling ~300k requests/day; wrote SSE stream reading, parsing, StateFlow, and fallback with capped retries; fixed stale price bug via version logging and index rebuild; considered alternatives (rebuild on every edit vs. no index) and explained trade-offs; validated fix manually but lacked timing logs or user data.

dimensions.name: current ability
dimensions.evidence: Designed mobile wallet with clear client/server/local storage ownership; specified Room suspend insert for durable intent before network call; used client transfer ID scoped per account; server-side transactional debit/credit with row locking; handled concurrent transfers and session generation to prevent cross-account response leakage; identified risks and mitigations independently.

dimensions.name: handling unknowns
dimensions.evidence: Clarified requirements before designing (balance custody, currencies, offline behavior); handled lost response with pending intent and status lookup by client ID; kept unknown state when lookup finds nothing and offered 'check again' without new ID; bound chat-initiated approval to payer/recipient/amount/expiry; addressed recipient change after confirmation with new intent and expiry.

dimensions.name: shipping product
dimensions.evidence: Identified delivery risk, escalated same day to PM with two options, PM decided to keep old pages; finished fix and testing personally; defined MVP scope (one currency, one rail, read-only offline); specified sign-off roles (tech lead, product owner, risk/compliance); incident response: pause submissions, keep reads working, own client fix, backend reconciliation, hard cap on pending transfers, escalation signals.

strongest: current ability: clear ownership boundaries, durable intent before network, server-authoritative ledger with transactional integrity, and robust handling of concurrency and session isolation.
risks: Limited production evidence for past work (manual validation only, no timing logs or user data); some repeated answers suggest possible communication or recall gaps; incident response ownership split with backend could create ambiguity under pressure.
